description: This file defines the AskV8GestureDetector class, a custom gesture detector extending Android's GestureDetector, handling multi-touch gestures including pinch and separate gestures, with specific logic for tracking the first finger in touch events.

classes.name: AskV8GestureDetector
classes.description: A custom gesture detector class that extends GestureDetector to handle multi-touch gestures, including pinch and separate gestures, with internal logic to track the first finger touch.

methods.name: AskV8GestureDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gesture detector with context and listener, setting up scale gesture detection.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events, manages tracking of the first finger, processes scale gestures, and delegates to superclass when appropriate.
